in_marathi.name: Anilabh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Anil + Abhaya = Fearless Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anilabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anilabh is a name derived from Sanskrit roots 'Anil' and 'Abhaya'. The first part, Anil, is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anila' which means wind or air. The second part, Abhaya, means 'fearlessness' or 'protection'. Together, Anilabh translates to 'Fearless Protection'. In Hindu mythology, Anil is one of the eight Vasus and represents the element of wind. The name is also associated with the Hindu god Vayu, the god of wind.
